_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Trying the steps on the page…

description: Run steps you wrote in Monity's own browser on the live page, without saving anything, and read the rows and what each step did. Use it after every change until the rows are right: a step that failed says why. Free; reads at most 5 pages and 50 rows, in up to 45 seconds. Set "outline": true to also get the page's elements with their css, when you cannot look at the page yourself. Read get_dataset_steps_guide first.

definition.description: The dataset's definition: { inputs, steps, rowKey?, limits? }. Read get_dataset_steps_guide first.

inputUrl.description: Which of the definition's start pages to try on (default: the first)

outline.description: Also return the page's elements (tag, text, css) at the point the steps stopped

untilStepId.description: Run only up to this step (its id). Default: every step.

uuid.description: When you are changing a saved dataset: its uuid, so its saved login and settings are used

name: try_dataset_steps
title: Try a dataset's steps
